name: Linear Board Sync
description: Keeps each Linked Workspace's Board Column in step with its Linear ticket.

settings.title: Teams
settings.description: Linear team keys to sync, separated by commas, spaces or new lines, for example OEO. Write <workspace>/<key> (the workspace as in your Linear URLs, linear.app/<workspace>/…) when a key exists in several Linear workspaces. Empty means all teams.

settings.title: State Mapping overrides
settings.description: JSON mapping Linear state names to Board Column ids, for example {"Blocked": "blocked", "Review": "in-review"}. Prefix a state with a team key to apply it to that team only: {"OEO/Review": "in-review"}. States not listed map by type: triage, backlog and unstarted to todo, started to in-progress, completed and canceled to completed.
